target.query: SELECT completed_at AS time, ('Scan completed · ' || source || ' · ' || files || ' docs · ' || COALESCE(avg_score,0) || '/100') AS text FROM scan_runs WHERE completed_at IS NOT NULL ORDER BY 1

description: ACP — Accessibility Compliance Platform: live compliance posture, findings, remediation, async queue, and audit trail (from Postgres).
title: ACP — Accessibility Compliance Platform

options.content:
### 📋 Document accessibility — at a glance
This shows how usable your documents are for people with disabilities, scored against the **WCAG 2.1** standard. **Score 0–100** (higher is better; **90+** can be certified). **Green = good · amber = needs attention · red = problem.** Each scan checks every document against dozens of rules — below are the latest results, trends, the most common problems, and the documents that need the most work.

panels.title: Avg compliance score
panels.description: Mean 0–100 WCAG compliance score of the most recent completed scan. Target ≥ 90.

targets.rawSql: SELECT avg_score AS value FROM scan_runs WHERE id='${scan}'

panels.title: Certifiable rate
panels.description: Share of documents in the latest scan that pass the rubric and can be certified.

targets.rawSql: SELECT ROUND(CAST(certifiable AS NUMERIC)/NULLIF(files,0),3) AS value FROM scan_runs WHERE id='${scan}'

panels.title: Open findings (latest)
panels.description: Total WCAG violations found across all documents in the most recent scan.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM issue_records WHERE scan_id = '${scan}'

panels.title: Awaiting human review
panels.description: Findings awaiting human review in the queue.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM hitl_queue WHERE status='pending'

panels.title: Processing now
panels.description: Async jobs currently queued or running in the worker pool.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM jobs WHERE status IN ('queued','running')

panels.title: Total scans
panels.description: Completed scans over time (with trend).

targets.rawSql: SELECT completed_at::timestamptz AS time, (ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY completed_at))::int AS "scans" FROM scan_runs WHERE completed_at IS NOT NULL ORDER BY completed_at

panels.title: Documents covered
panels.description: Unique documents seen across all scans (idempotent inventory).

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM inventory

panels.title: Stuck items (need attention)
panels.description: Async jobs that exhausted retries — need attention.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM jobs WHERE status='dead'

panels.title: Compliance score over time
panels.description: Average score per scan. The dashed line is the 90 certification target.

targets.rawSql: SELECT completed_at::timestamptz AS time, avg_score AS "avg score" FROM scan_runs WHERE completed_at IS NOT NULL AND source LIKE '${source}' ORDER BY completed_at

panels.title: Scan outcomes over time
panels.description: Per-scan breakdown: certifiable vs. needs-work vs. uncertain vs. error.

targets.rawSql: SELECT completed_at::timestamptz AS time, certifiable, GREATEST(files-certifiable-uncertain-error,0) AS "needs work", uncertain, error FROM scan_runs WHERE completed_at IS NOT NULL AND source LIKE '${source}' ORDER BY completed_at

panels.title: Findings by severity
panels.description: All recorded WCAG violations by severity.

targets.rawSql: SELECT severity, COUNT(*) AS value FROM issue_records WHERE scan_id='${scan}' GROUP BY severity ORDER BY value DESC

panels.title: Most common accessibility problems
panels.description: The issues found most often, in plain language (e.g. 'Non-text Content' = images missing a text description).

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(plain_name,''), NULLIF(rule_name,''), rule_id) AS metric, SUM(finding_count) AS value FROM scan_rule_traces WHERE outcome='FAIL' AND scan_id='${scan}' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY value DESC LIMIT 12

panels.title: Lowest-scoring documents (latest scan)
panels.description: The documents most in need of remediation in the most recent scan.

targets.rawSql: SELECT file, engine, status, score FROM file_records WHERE scan_id = '${scan}' ORDER BY score ASC LIMIT 12

panels.title: Rule coverage (latest scan)
panels.description: Every rule evaluation in the latest scan: passed, failed, errored, or not-applicable to the file type. Proves completeness.

targets.rawSql: SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS value FROM scan_file_manifests WHERE scan_id = '${scan}' GROUP BY status

panels.title: Avg score by engine (latest)
panels.description: Compliance score by document engine — which formats fare best.

targets.rawSql: SELECT engine AS metric, ROUND(AVG(score)) AS value FROM file_records WHERE scan_id = '${scan}' GROUP BY engine ORDER BY value

panels.title: File status (latest scan)
panels.description: Per-document outcome in the latest scan.

targets.rawSql: SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS value FROM file_records WHERE scan_id = '${scan}' GROUP BY status

panels.title: Human-review outcomes
panels.description: Human-review items by disposition.

targets.rawSql: SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS value FROM hitl_queue GROUP BY status

panels.title: Issues awaiting review
panels.description: Which rules are stacking up in the human-review queue.

targets.rawSql: SELECT rule_name AS metric, COUNT(*) AS value FROM hitl_queue WHERE status='pending' GROUP BY rule_name ORDER BY value DESC LIMIT 8

panels.title: Files remediated
panels.description: Documents with a remediation written back to source.

targets.rawSql: SELECT remediated_at::timestamptz AS time, (ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY remediated_at))::int AS "remediated" FROM file_records WHERE remediated_at IS NOT NULL ORDER BY remediated_at
SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS value FROM jobs GROUP BY status
SELECT type AS metric, COUNT(*) AS value FROM jobs GROUP BY type ORDER BY value DESC

panels.title: Work completed over time
panels.description: Jobs finishing over time — worker-pool throughput.

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('minute', updated_at::timestamptz) AS time, COUNT(*) AS "completed" FROM jobs WHERE status='done' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Audit trail · what happened and when
Recent decisions
panels.description: Append-only record of every consequential action — scan mode, auto-routing, HITL reviews, remediation, settings.

targets.rawSql: SELECT ts AS "when", actor, action, file, rule_id, detail FROM decision_log ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 50

panels.title: Documents with sensitive data
panels.description: Documents found to contain PII (SSNs, cards, emails, phone numbers) in the latest scan.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT file) AS value FROM pii_findings WHERE scan_id='${scan}'

panels.title: Sensitive items found
panels.description: Total count of sensitive values across all documents in the latest scan.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(count),0) AS value FROM pii_findings WHERE scan_id='${scan}'

panels.title: Sensitive data by type
panels.description: What kind of sensitive data was found (latest scan).

targets.rawSql: SELECT label AS metric, SUM(count) AS value FROM pii_findings WHERE scan_id='${scan}' GROUP BY label ORDER BY value DESC

panels.title: Documents exposing sensitive data (masked samples)
panels.description: Per-document sensitive-data findings. Samples are masked — raw values are never stored.

targets.rawSql: SELECT file, label AS type, count, severity, samples FROM pii_findings WHERE scan_id='${scan}' ORDER BY count DESC LIMIT 50

panels.title: Failures by WCAG level (A / AA / AAA)
panels.description: How the selected scan's failures break down by WCAG conformance level. Level A = most basic, AA = legal baseline (ADA/EAA), AAA = enhanced.

targets.rawSql: SELECT level, SUM(finding_count) AS value FROM scan_rule_traces WHERE outcome='FAIL' AND scan_id='${scan}' GROUP BY level ORDER BY level

panels.title: Failing rules by level (plain names)
panels.description: Top failing checks for the selected scan, labeled in plain language, colored by WCAG level.

targets.rawSql: SELECT (level || ' · ' || COALESCE(NULLIF(plain_name,''), rule_name)) AS metric, SUM(finding_count) AS value FROM scan_rule_traces WHERE outcome='FAIL' AND scan_id='${scan}' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY value DESC LIMIT 10

panels.title: Rule outcomes for the selected file
panels.description: Every WCAG rule checked against the file selected in the File dropdown above — pass/fail, level, and how it's fixed. Change the File variable to inspect a different document.

targets.rawSql: SELECT rule_id, COALESCE(NULLIF(plain_name,''), rule_name) AS rule, level, fix_mode, outcome, finding_count FROM scan_rule_traces WHERE scan_id='${scan}' AND file='${file}' ORDER BY rule_id

panels.title: Remediation funnel (selected scan)
panels.description: How far documents from the selected scan have moved through the pipeline: scanned → flagged non-compliant → auto-remediated → reviewed by a human (HITL) → published.

targets.rawSql: SELECT 'Scanned' AS metric, COUNT(*) AS value, 1 AS ord FROM file_records WHERE scan_id='${scan}' UNION ALL SELECT 'Flagged (non-compliant)', COUNT(*), 2 FROM file_records WHERE scan_id='${scan}' AND compliant=0 UNION ALL SELECT 'Auto-remediated', COUNT(*), 3 FROM file_records WHERE scan_id='${scan}' AND remediated_at IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT 'HITL-reviewed', COUNT(DISTINCT file), 4 FROM hitl_queue WHERE scan_id='${scan}' AND status IN ('approved','rejected','skipped') UNION ALL SELECT 'Published', COUNT(*), 5 FROM file_records WHERE scan_id='${scan}' AND published_at IS NOT NULL ORDER BY ord

panels.title: Alert-to-resolution latency
panels.description: Time between a Grafana alert firing and it resolving, computed from the immutable decision log (every alert.firing/alert.resolved delivered via the ACP webhook). Helps gauge how quickly an ops lead actually responds.

targets.rawSql: WITH ev AS ( SELECT ts, action, split_part(detail, ':', 1) AS alert_name, LAG(ts) OVER (PARTITION BY split_part(detail, ':', 1) ORDER BY ts) AS prev_ts, LAG(action) OVER (PARTITION BY split_part(detail, ':', 1) ORDER BY ts) AS prev_action FROM decision_log WHERE actor='grafana' AND action IN ('alert.firing','alert.resolved')) SELECT alert_name, prev_ts AS fired_at, ts AS resolved_at, ROUND(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (ts::timestamptz - prev_ts::timestamptz))/60) AS minutes_to_resolve FROM ev WHERE action='alert.resolved' AND prev_action='alert.firing' ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 20

list.name: source
list.label: Source
list.query: SELECT 'All' AS __text, '%' AS __value UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT source, source FROM scan_runs ORDER BY 1

list.name: scan
list.label: Scan
list.query: SELECT (completed_at || ' · ' || source || ' · ' || files || ' docs · ' || COALESCE(avg_score,0) || '/100') AS __text, id AS __value FROM scan_runs WHERE completed_at IS NOT NULL AND source LIKE '${source}' ORDER BY completed_at DESC

list.name: file
list.label: File
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT file AS __text, file AS __value FROM file_records WHERE scan_id='${scan}' ORDER BY 1
